title:
19
  F NMR-tags for peptidyl prolyl conformation analysis
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00118H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
George S. M. Hanson, Faidra Batsaki, Teagan L. Myerscough, Kristin Piché, Ariel Louwrier, Christopher R. Coxon
We evaluate fluorinated reagents for tagging cysteine in proline-containing peptides and use 19F NMR to measure %cis-Pro. One tag shows fast kinetics in aqueous buffer and enables tagging of α-synuclein for 19F NMR studies.
